Tooltip_CFP_BuildShore: Attaches one walkable vanilla shoreline graphic to the existing ground. Requires 5 L of water in a metal bucket, one use (quarter bag) of sand, a shovel or spade, and Carpentry 6. Four corners and two profiles for each edge are available.
Tooltip_CFP_BuildCenter: Builds one true vanilla water tile recognized by fishing and fishing nets. Requires one full 10 L metal bucket of water, a shovel or spade, and Carpentry 6. Several adjacent centers give the bobber room to move.
Tooltip_CFP_FillTile: Removes one center or shoreline tile made by this mod. Requires two uses (half a bag) of dirt and a shovel or spade. A complete 3x3 pond costs 4.5 full dirt bags to remove.
